pages.text: Forge a Soul Catcher from a Spirit Core template, a Lead base, and Primordial Qi.

Use it on a creature to preserve and contain its full entity data. A filled catcher glints and names its occupant in the tooltip; use it on valid empty ground to release the creature. Creative mode updates the held stack correctly as well.

The Soul Catcher accepts vanilla and modded creatures and can supply a specimen to the Simulated Reincarnation Furnace. Capture and release are disabled during tribulation so its target flow cannot be bypassed.
